name: review-kit
description: A planner, a build coordinator, an auditor, two review agents, a prose hook and a voice system. The planner interviews you into a spec another agent can build from; the coordinator dispatches that build and checks what comes back without writing code itself; the auditor is the last look at the whole change; the review agents judge design and comments; the hook catches the register and formatting tells a grep can be sure about. Everything repo-specific comes from a profile file the target repository owns.
